basics.name: Abhishek Kumar
basics.title: Full-Stack Developer and AI Enthusiast
basics.summary: Full-Stack Developer and AI Enthusiast with a strong foundation in backend development, data structures, and algorithms. Experienced in building secure, scalable web applications with modern frameworks and authentication systems and exploring AI-driven solutions to solve real-world problems and deliver meaningful user impact.

bullets: Built an end-to-end ML pipeline using Python, Pandas, and Scikit-learn to predict football transfer values from 10,000+ match records.
Engineered 25+ performance features and optimized regression models (Linear Regression, XGBoost), improving RMSE by 18% and achieving R-squared of 0.87.

achievements.title: 300+ DSA Problems
achievements.context: Solved 300+ Data Structures and Algorithms problems across arrays, strings, hashing, recursion, and trees on platforms like LeetCode and GeeksforGeeks.

achievements.title: Open Source Contributor
achievements.context: Contributor at GirlScript Summer of Code 2024.

projects.title: TravelUp
bullets: Developed a full-stack travel platform using the MERN stack with JWT-based authentication and RESTful API architecture.
Designed MongoDB schemas and implemented CRUD operations for listings, bookings, and user management.
Structured backend routes to handle concurrent user interactions and secure session management.

projects.title: TransferIQ: Player Transfer Value Prediction
bullets: Built an ML pipeline combining performance, injury, and sentiment data to predict football player transfer values.
Developed univariate and multivariate LSTM models for forecasting transfer values across multiple time horizons.
Applied ensemble learning (LSTM + XGBoost) achieving R-squared of 0.87 and 18% RMSE improvement over baseline.

projects.title: AI Exam Notes Generator
projects.stack: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Gemini API, Stripe
bullets: Engineered an AI SaaS platform generating exam notes, diagrams, and revision summaries using LLM APIs.
Implemented a credit-based monetization system with Stripe payments and token-based authentication.
Deployed a scalable production system supporting concurrent AI content generation requests.
